_readme: AI assistant. `faqs` power demo mode (server-side intent matching: `intents` are keywords scored against the visitor's message). `systemPromptTemplate` + `knowledgeBase` power live mode when an LLM_API_KEY is configured. Keep both in sync with your real story.
label: ai assistant
heading: Ask me anything.
description: A small demo of how I build AI features: this assistant answers questions about my work using a structured knowledge base — intent matching, streamed responses, graceful fallbacks.

disclaimer.demo: ▸ demo mode — answers come from a local knowledge base via intent matching · no LLM, no API key needed · swap-ready for a live model
disclaimer.live: ▸ live mode — answers are generated by an LLM grounded in a curated knowledge base · it can make mistakes, so verify anything important

greeting: Hi — I'm John's AI assistant. Ask about his full-stack work, infrastructure and DevSecOps, security engineering, or availability — or tap a suggested question.

knowledgeBase.summary: John Filhmar Ola is a Lead IT and full-stack engineer based in Dasmariñas, Cavite, Philippines (UTC+8). At YouCode Technologies he owns multiple production systems end to end — architecture, full-stack development, CI/CD, security automation, and on-premise infrastructure — and was promoted from Developer to Lead IT within his first year. Open to conversations; he replies to email within 24 hours.

sections.title: Strengths
sections.content: Owning systems end to end, from first commit to production operation. John is the sole developer of Usapp, a secure real-time messaging platform spanning mobile client, distributed backend microservices, deployment pipeline and production server management. He is equally at home in full-stack development, DevSecOps pipelines, and on-premise infrastructure.

sections.title: Projects
sections.content: At YouCode Technologies (all sole-developed; internal architecture, structure and stack withheld under NDA): Usapp — a secure real-time messaging platform and the notification backbone for the company's product suite; a per-client HR platform (HRIS) covering the full employee lifecycle for government and private organisations; a white-label civic super-app live for three cities (MyDasma / Dasmariñas, MySorsogon / Sorsogon City, MyLegazpi / Legazpi); an offline-first learning platform (LMS) with on-device exams and verifiable micro-credentials; and the YouGuard edge bridge linking on-site access-control and camera hardware to the cloud. Independent work: JMS E-Talyer — multi-branch automotive service management, live on a self-managed VPS with a four-workflow CI/CD pipeline and layered security scanning. PeraPlano — privacy-first Android budgeting app that derives tracking from transaction push notifications; in development. Kalusugapp — digital health records for rural clinics. Flood Notification System — IoT early-warning with sirens, warning lights and GSM SMS.

sections.title: Stack
sections.content: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, PHP, C/C++, Bash. Frontend/mobile: React, React Native (Expo), TailwindCSS. Backend: NestJS, Node.js, gRPC, RabbitMQ, WebSockets, microservices. Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis. DevSecOps/infra: Docker, GitHub Actions, self-hosted runners, Traefik, nginx, Linux, on-premise VPS. Security: Semgrep, CodeQL, Trivy, gitleaks, cosign, SBOM/SLSA. Monitoring/testing: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, k6.

sections.title: Career
sections.content: Feb–May 2025: Ynnovision Enterprise Solutions — 486-hour frontend/web development internship. Jul 2025–now: YouCode Technologies — joined as Developer and was promoted to Lead IT within the first year; owns multiple production systems, CI/CD across the product suite, and on-premise infrastructure operations.

sections.title: Contact & availability
sections.content: Email olajohnfilhmar@gmail.com — replies within 24 hours. Based in Dasmariñas, Cavite, Philippines (UTC+8). Open to conversations about full-stack, DevSecOps and infrastructure roles and collaborations. LinkedIn and GitHub links are in the contact section.

faqs.question: What's your strongest area?
faqs.answer: John's strongest area is owning systems end to end — from architecture and full-stack code to CI/CD, security and the on-premise servers it runs on. He built Usapp, a secure real-time messaging platform, single-handedly across mobile, distributed microservices, deployment pipeline and production infrastructure.

faqs.question: Tell me about your full-stack work
faqs.answer: John builds across the whole stack: React and React Native on the front, NestJS/Node microservices behind them, and PostgreSQL/MongoDB/MySQL/Redis for data. JMS E-Talyer is a good example — a multi-branch automotive service system he built, secured, deployed and now operates himself.

faqs.question: What have you built at YouCode?
faqs.answer: At YouCode Technologies John is the sole developer behind several production systems (details withheld under NDA): Usapp, a secure real-time messaging platform; a per-client HR platform covering the full employee lifecycle; a white-label civic super-app now live for three cities (MyDasma, MySorsogon, MyLegazpi); an offline-first learning platform with on-device exams and verifiable credentials; and the YouGuard edge bridge linking on-site access-control and camera hardware to the cloud. He owns each end to end — mobile/web, backend, and deployment.

faqs.question: What about backend and distributed systems?
faqs.answer: Deep experience. Usapp is a distributed microservice backend with real-time messaging and push delivery, built from scratch and now the notification backbone for his company's entire product suite. He works across REST, gRPC, WebSockets and message queues (RabbitMQ), and designs services to be owned end to end.

faqs.question: How do you approach DevSecOps and CI/CD?
faqs.answer: John owns CI/CD across a whole product suite — automated build, test, security scanning, artifact signing and deployment, including self-hosted runner infrastructure. JMS E-Talyer runs a four-workflow pipeline (integration, security scanning, gated deployment, dependency management) with hardened, non-root containers and secrets injected at runtime.

faqs.question: Do you manage infrastructure?
faqs.answer: Yes — he leads on-premise infrastructure operations: server provisioning, container orchestration, monitoring stack deployment, and production incident diagnosis. For JMS E-Talyer he provisions, secures, manages and operates the VPS himself, end to end.

faqs.question: What about security?
faqs.answer: Security is baked into his pipelines, not bolted on: static analysis, dependency auditing, secret scanning across full git history, dynamic testing and container vulnerability scanning, plus signed artifacts and SBOM/SLSA provenance. Application-side he does security headers, origin allow-listing, tiered rate limiting, scoped CSRF and error sanitisation.

faqs.question: Do you do hardware/IoT?
faqs.answer: He does. The Flood Notification System is a sensor-based early-warning platform with sirens, warning lights and GSM SMS dispatch that tracks both water level and rate of rise per area. He's also built hardware-to-server integration for a campus attendance and security system.

faqs.question: What mobile work have you done?
faqs.answer: John builds mobile in React Native (Expo). PeraPlano is his privacy-first Android budgeting app: user financial data is encrypted, and income/expense tracking is derived from transaction push notifications so users don't have to log entries manually. He also built the Usapp mobile client with push notification delivery.

faqs.question: Have you led teams?
faqs.answer: Yes — he was promoted from Developer to Lead IT at YouCode Technologies within his first year, and now owns multiple production systems across the company. His practice covers full-stack ownership, microservice design, code review, technical documentation and agile delivery.

faqs.question: What's your tech stack?
faqs.answer: Daily drivers: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, PHP. Frontend/mobile: React, React Native, Tailwind. Backend: NestJS, Node, gRPC, RabbitMQ, WebSockets. Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis. Infra/DevSecOps: Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux, Traefik, nginx, on-premise VPS. Security/observability: Semgrep, CodeQL, Trivy, cosign, Prometheus, Grafana, k6.

faqs.question: Where are you based?
faqs.answer: John is based in Dasmariñas, Cavite, Philippines (UTC+8). He's open to conversations about full-stack, DevSecOps and infrastructure roles and collaborations — reach out and share a line about the problem space.

faqs.question: How do I contact you?
faqs.answer: Email olajohnfilhmar@gmail.com — he replies within 24 hours. LinkedIn and GitHub links are in the contact section. A one-line description of the problem space is the fastest way to a great reply.

faqs.question: What roles are you open to?
faqs.answer: He's open to conversations about full-stack, DevSecOps and infrastructure roles and collaborations — especially work where owning a system end to end matters. Currently Lead IT at YouCode Technologies.

faqs.question: What's your background?
faqs.answer: A fast arc: a 486-hour frontend/web development internship at Ynnovision Enterprise Solutions (Feb–May 2025), then YouCode Technologies (Jul 2025–now), where he joined as a Developer and was promoted to Lead IT within his first year — now owning multiple production systems, CI/CD, and on-premise infrastructure.

faqs.question: Where's your résumé?
faqs.answer: There's a résumé link in the contact section (résumé.pdf ↓). Short version: Lead IT and full-stack engineer who owns systems end to end — mobile, backend microservices, CI/CD, security and on-premise infrastructure.

faqs.question: How does this assistant work?
faqs.answer: Honest answer: out of the box I'm a demo — a curated knowledge base with intent matching and streamed responses, served by a small API route. Add one API key to the server config and the same route upgrades me to a live LLM with the same knowledge base. John built me this way on purpose.

faqs.question: Say hi
faqs.answer: Hey! Ask me about John's full-stack work, backend and microservices, DevSecOps and infrastructure, security, mobile/IoT, or availability. Or tap one of the suggested questions.
